dependency_method.type: per-feature Ridge from all other contemporaneous features

interpretation.auc_rule: AUC > 0.5 means the diagnostic tends to be larger for GT events than current MSRS false alarms; values near 0.5 mean little separation.
interpretation.dependency: If dependency AUC is clearly > 0.5, a relation-verification branch is justified.
interpretation.persistence: If persistence AUC is clearly > 0.5, temporal persistence gating is justified.
interpretation.sparse_count: If sparse-feature-count AUC is > 0.5, GT events tend to affect more variables than false alarms; if < 0.5, false alarms may be broader than GT.
